name: Songbirds of the Seventies
hours_label: Evening & matinee shows, Tue-Sun · Tickets from ~$29
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre's summer cabaret is a tribute to the powerhouse women who defined the '60s and '70s - Joni Mitchell, Carole King, Carly Simon, Stevie Nicks, Linda Ronstadt and Helen Reddy. Cocktails and small plates at your table in the intimate Court Cabaret. A relaxed downtown night out; check FST for showtimes.

name: Summer Circus Spectacular
venue: Historic Asolo Theater at The Ringling
hours_label: Tue-Fri 11 AM & 2 PM, Sat 2 PM & 5 PM · $20 adults / $15 kids 12 & under
blurb: Last call: The Ringling and The Circus Arts Conservatory wrap their summer run Aug 8 with a fast-paced, family-friendly hour of acrobats, Cyr wheel, contortion and clowning inside the air-conditioned Historic Asolo Theater. Add the Circus Museum the same day for just $5 more. Saturday Aug 8 is the final performance of the season.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
venue: Siesta Beach, south of the pavilion
blurb: Every Sunday a crowd of drummers, dancers, hoopers and fire spinners gathers on the quartz sand just south of the Siesta Beach pavilion to play the sun down. Free, informal and welcoming - bring a chair, a drum, or just watch. One of the most iconic scenes on the Key.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
venue: Downtown Sarasota - Lemon Ave & Main St
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's Saturday institution fills Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, seafood, baked goods, flowers, coffee and live music. Free to browse; come early for parking and the cooler part of the morning. An easy way to feel out the downtown neighborhood if you're house-hunting.
